Own work
This file was derived from:  Coat of arms of Annam - Hymnes et pavillons d'Indochine (Hanoï - 1941) 01.svg
Information from:

dcvonline.net
Requested by and knowledge from Donald Trung
This coat of arms can also be seen on Nguyễn Dynasty porcelain, as can be seen on the cover of the book "Đồ gốm sứ Châu Âu tại Bảo tàng cổ vật cung đình Huế" (The European ceramics at the Hue Royal Antiques Museum) and is featured in the book Đồ sứ ký kiểu thời Nguyễn. It is depicted with the same colours on ceramics from the Khải Định period.
attribution.description:
Illustration of:
The coat of arms of the Empire of Annam (Nguyễn Dynasty) during the French protectorate period as recorded in the books Hymnes et pavillons d'Indochine (1941) and Bao Daï, Le Dragon d'Annam (1980).
